thread:
maria: Quick pulse — need owners for the console dashboards shipping EOW (Fri). Specifically: dashboard views (svc latency, errorflow), tracing hooks, and the error-analysis panels. Who's picking what? Any blockers? :eyes:

jonathan: I can take dashboards (svc latency + cost panel). Blocker: backend_metrics team changed the latency metric name last night -> I need updated metric name and example query. ping @sophie from eng-infra.

sophie: sorry, that change slipped. New metric is `svc.request.lat_ms_p95`. Example query: `avg_over_time(svc.request.lat_ms_p95[5m])`. Jon, I'll drop a PR with the dashboard vars by EOD. :white_check_mark:

ashley: I can own trace hooks and errorflow integration, but need the tracing schema (span tags) and the service attribute we'll use for aggregation. Is `service.name` stable? @kevin?

kevin: service.name is stable. For spans we added `span.kind` and `http.status_class` last week. Ashley, I'll paste the schema in a minute.

kevin: ```
span.tags = ["service.name", "span.kind", "http.status_code", "http.status_class", "error"]
retention_policy = "14d"
```

maria: retention policy: default 14d for hosted console. Enterprise customers can opt into 30d on Dedicated/Private. We're final on that unless security raises concerns. @samir can you confirm logs retention docs link?

samir: Confirmed — doc updated: https://go/redwood/obs-retention (internal). I'll also create a short note for the console onboarding checklist.

deploy-bot: Canary for `console-observability-ui` scheduled at 2024-11-06T16:30Z to roll 5% -> 50%.

jonathan: thanks @sophie and @kevin. Action items from this thread:
- jonathan: finish dashboard json + PR (today)
- ashley: trace hooks impl + tests (tomorrow)
- kevin: paste schema + sample spans (in thread)
- samir: update onboarding note + link in PR

maria: If nobody objects, I'll mark owners in the roadmap and set a hard deadline EOW. If you need more time, shout now. :loud_sound:

ashley: all good, might need an extra day for e2e tests — OK if deadline shifts to Mon?

maria: fine — move to Mon morning. Thanks all! :tada:
